cuts.name: cover
cuts.alt: Her project cover: a glitched close-up of leaf veins, pink-red leaf flesh between dark green veins, with pixel blocks and colour bands breaking up the bottom.

cuts.name: moodboard
cuts.alt: Her inspiration and silhouette board: a collage of a giant leaf, mushrooms, Venus flytraps, moss, an uncanny face and knit, ruffled and layered references, with four Pantone chips and her labels.

cuts.name: inspiration
cuts.alt: The INSPIRATION half of her board: a giant leaf, mushrooms, Venus flytraps, moss, curling green tendrils, dark hair and an uncanny face, labelled ominous, raw, textures, earthy and uncanny, with four Pantone chips.

cuts.name: silhouette
cuts.alt: The SILHOUTTE half of her board: a strapless pink bodycon gown, an oversized ribbed turtleneck, a flared gown, layered rough-edged fabric, pink ruffles, a patchwork knit and two flytrap embellishments, each labelled.

cuts.name: lineup
cuts.alt: Her line-up of eleven illustrated looks in pink and lime green: ribbed stripes, ruffled edges, long sleeves, wide trousers, draped skirts and column dresses, with small flower embellishments.
